guard: owner-authorized auth-service renewal preserves actor/lifecycle/nkey, confines every mint to current authority within its ceiling, and keeps legacy static families as named mesh-release blockers
why: Each mutation removes one load-bearing authorization or release-honesty check and must die on the named assertion rather than on setup.
The suite performs two accelerated renewals without a broker or live service, keeping the item-4 real manager service exit explicitly outside this fixture.
The session-agent matrix row remains frozen and the mint consumes the private module-load TTL snapshot, so exported policy mutation cannot change issued lifetime.

mutations.name: session renewal admits supervise
mutations.find:
if (capabilities.includes("supervise"))
    refuse("permission-denied", "session renewal authority must never include supervise; renewal is not management authority");
mutations.replace:
if (false && capabilities.includes("supervise"))
    refuse("permission-denied", "session renewal authority must never include supervise; renewal is not management authority");
mutations.expectRed: supervise is never admitted as renewal authority
mutations.cell: supervise is never admitted as renewal authority

mutations.name: holder proof verification is bypassed
mutations.find: if (!verified) refuse("permission-denied", "session renewal holder proof does not verify for the lifecycle's existing nkey");
mutations.replace: if (false && !verified) refuse("permission-denied", "session renewal holder proof does not verify for the lifecycle's existing nkey");
mutations.expectRed: holder proof is bound to the lifecycle's existing nkey
mutations.cell: holder proof is bound to the lifecycle's existing nkey

mutations.name: fresh ACL can exceed capability ceiling
mutations.replace: // MUTANT: skip the fresh read ACL ceiling check
mutations.expectRed: fresh current ACL cannot exceed the owner-authorized ceiling
mutations.cell: fresh current ACL cannot exceed the owner-authorized ceiling

mutations.name: request replay mints twice
mutations.find:
if (!await args.consumeRequestId(capability.capabilityId, request.requestId))
    refuse("permission-denied", `session renewal request ${request.requestId} was already consumed; replay never mints twice`);
mutations.replace:
if (false && !await args.consumeRequestId(capability.capabilityId, request.requestId))
    refuse("permission-denied", `session renewal request ${request.requestId} was already consumed; replay never mints twice`);
mutations.expectRed: a replayed renewal request cannot mint a second generation
mutations.cell: a replayed renewal request cannot mint a second generation

mutations.name: legacy agent family is mislabeled release-ready
mutations.find:
if (family === INDEPENDENT_SESSION_CREDENTIAL_FAMILY)
    return { status: "independently-renewable", family, renewalOwner: INDEPENDENT_SESSION_RENEWAL_OWNER };
mutations.replace:
if (family === INDEPENDENT_SESSION_CREDENTIAL_FAMILY || family === "agent")
    return { status: "independently-renewable", family, renewalOwner: INDEPENDENT_SESSION_RENEWAL_OWNER };
mutations.expectRed: legacy static and mixed session identity families remain named release blockers
mutations.cell: legacy static and mixed session identity families remain named release blockers
